### To the Church of God in Corinth
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/to-the-church-of-god-in-corinth
Passage: 1 Corinthians 1:1-3
Points:
- Ancient Corinth was a commercial hub whose pervasive cultural vices quickly infiltrated the local congregation.
- Despite their practical failures and sins, Paul addresses the believers as already sanctified in Christ.
- Believers do not achieve holiness by their own power; it is an identity conferred through Christ.
- Christian discipleship means learning to live out the holy standing God has already granted.

### Daily Disciples - Oct.13, 2010
Author: Daily Disciples Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-oct13-2010-11639413.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 1:1-2
Points:
- Biblical sainthood begins at salvation when a believer is consecrated to God, not after death or via statues.
- Paul reminded the Corinthians of their holy calling despite the church's ongoing struggles with pride and division.
- A Christian's status as a saint rests entirely on faith in Christ rather than personal works.
- Believers must evaluate their daily habits to ensure their conduct reflects their true calling in Christ.
